name: Verification code
description: A one-time code to verify a phone number or an action.
body: {{code}} is your verification code. It expires in {{minutes}} minutes. Never share it with anyone.

name: Sign-in code
description: A one-time code to finish signing in.
body: Your sign-in code is {{code}}. If you did not try to sign in, you can ignore this message.

name: Order shipped
description: Tell a customer their order is on its way, with a tracking link.
body: Hi {{firstName}}, your order {{orderId}} has shipped. Track it here: {{trackingUrl}}

name: Appointment reminder
description: Remind a customer of an upcoming appointment.
body: Reminder: your appointment with {{businessName}} is on {{date}} at {{time}}. Reply C to cancel.

name: Payment received
description: Confirm that a payment arrived.
body: We received your payment of {{amount}} for invoice {{invoiceNumber}}. Thank you for your business.

name: Sale with a code
description: Announce a sale with a discount code, with an opt-out.
body: {{businessName}}: {{discount}} off everything until {{endDate}}. Use code {{promoCode}} at checkout. Reply STOP to opt out.

name: Back in stock
description: Tell a customer a product they wanted is available again, with an opt-out.
body: Good news, {{firstName}}: {{productName}} is back in stock. Reply STOP to opt out.

name: Verification code
description: A one-time code to verify an e-mail address or an action.
subject: Your verification code
body:
Hi {{firstName}},

Your verification code is {{code}}. It expires in {{minutes}} minutes.

If you did not ask for this code, you can ignore this e-mail. Never share the code with anyone.

The {{businessName}} team

name: Welcome
description: Welcome a new customer after they sign up.
subject: Welcome to {{businessName}}, {{firstName}}
body:
Hi {{firstName}},

Thanks for joining {{businessName}}. Your account is ready, and you can sign in at any time here: {{signInUrl}}

If you have any questions, just reply to this e-mail.

The {{businessName}} team

name: Password reset
description: Send a link to choose a new password.
subject: Reset your password
body:
Hi {{firstName}},

We received a request to reset your password. Choose a new one here: {{resetUrl}}

The link expires in {{minutes}} minutes. If you did not ask to reset your password, you can ignore this e-mail and your password stays the same.

The {{businessName}} team

name: Order confirmation
description: Confirm an order with its total and delivery date.
subject: Order {{orderId}} confirmed

name: Invoice ready
description: Tell a customer a new invoice is ready to view and pay.
subject: Your invoice {{invoiceNumber}} is ready
body:
Hi {{firstName}},

Your invoice {{invoiceNumber}} for {{amount}} is ready. Please pay it by {{dueDate}}.

View and pay the invoice here: {{invoiceUrl}}

The {{businessName}} team

name: Offer with a code
description: Send a discount code with an end date and an unsubscribe link.
subject: {{discount}} off for you, {{firstName}}

name: We miss you
description: Invite back a customer who has not ordered for a while.
subject: We miss you, {{firstName}}

name: Verification code
description: A one-time code to verify a phone number or an action.
body: Your {{businessName}} verification code is {{code}}. It expires in {{minutes}} minutes. Do not share this code with anyone.

name: Order shipped
description: Tell a customer their order is on its way, with a tracking link.
body: Hi {{firstName}}, your order {{orderId}} is on its way. Track your parcel at {{trackingUrl}} and reply here if you need help.

name: Appointment reminder
description: Remind a customer of an appointment and ask them to confirm.
body: Hello {{firstName}}, this is a reminder of your appointment with {{businessName}} on {{date}} at {{time}}. Reply YES to confirm or NO to cancel.

name: Delivery today
description: Tell a customer their order arrives today and when.
body: Hi {{firstName}}, your order {{orderId}} arrives today between {{timeWindow}}. Please make sure someone is available to receive it.

name: Offer with a code
description: Send a discount code with an end date and an opt-out.
body: Hi {{firstName}}, enjoy {{discount}} off at {{businessName}} until {{endDate}} with code {{promoCode}}. Reply STOP to stop receiving offers.

name: Back in stock
description: Tell a customer a product they wanted is available again, with an opt-out.
body: Good news, {{firstName}}! {{productName}} is back in stock. Reply STOP to stop receiving offers.

name: Sign-in code
description: A one-time code to finish signing in.
subject: Your sign-in code
body: Use {{code}} to finish signing in. It expires in {{minutes}} minutes.

name: Out for delivery
description: Tell a customer their order arrives today.
subject: Your order is out for delivery
body: Order {{orderId}} arrives today. Tap to track it.

name: Payment received
description: Confirm that a payment arrived.
subject: Payment received
body: We received your payment of {{amount}}. Thank you!

name: Appointment reminder
description: Remind a customer of an appointment the next day.
subject: Your appointment is tomorrow
body: See you at {{time}} with {{businessName}}. Tap to view or reschedule.

name: Flash sale
description: Announce a sale that ends today.
subject: {{discount}} off today only
body: {{firstName}}, the sale ends at midnight. Tap to shop now.

name: Cart reminder
description: Remind a customer of what is still in their cart.
subject: You left something behind
body: {{productName}} is still in your cart. Tap to complete your order.
